name: datacompredia
description: Interactive Data Communication and Networking laboratory

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client --if-present && npm run lint -w server --if-present
